payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Avery planning proposal: prioritize strict meetings full-window: m015 Job interview [0,1) and m007 University class [13,14). For soft meetings, to avoid overlap penalties I suggest one meeting per time region with broad overlap: m010 art [1,3) (skip interview conflict at [0,1)); m001 volleyball [3,5); m014 friends [5,7) instead of m002/m006/m009 overlap cluster; m004 study [7,9); m003 gym [9,10) or [8,9) depending others; m008 friends [10,13) instead of m016; then m007 [13,14). Happy to adjust if group converges on different anchors, but I want a non-overlapping chain maximizing overlap opportunities.

Reese planning: I agree on a non-overlapping chain and full attendance for strict m005 Doctor [0,1). That means I should skip m015 Job interview since it fully conflicts and we can't both get strict reward. For soft meetings, tentative Reese chain: m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), m012 music [5,7), m004 study [7,9), m003 gym [9,10), m008 or m013 [10,13) (prefer whichever others choose, but not both), then idle after 13. This avoids self-overlap and gives broad overlap opportunities. If others can align especially on m010/m001/m012/m004/m003 and one of m008/m013, that seems strong.

Riley planning proposal: because m005 Doctor [0,1) and m015 Job interview [0,1) fully conflict and both are strict, I propose Riley attends m005 full [0,1) and skips m015. Then use a non-overlapping soft chain aligned with Avery/Reese where possible: m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), m012 music [5,7), m004 study [7,9), m003 gym [9,10), m016 music [10,13), and m007 University class full [13,14). I would skip m011/m002/m006/m009 to avoid overlap penalties with adjacent choices. If others prefer friends hangout [3,7) over the split volleyball+music, I can reconsider, but current preference is this chain for clean coordination.

Taylor planning: I also favor strict full attendance for m005 Doctor [0,1) and m007 University class [13,14). For soft meetings, to avoid overlap penalties I propose a non-overlapping chain close to Reese/Riley: m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), m012 music [5,7), then one study block m004 [7,9) (or m006 [7,9) if group prefers, but not both), m003 gym [9,10), then one late block m008 friends [10,13) or m013 art [10,13) or m016 music [10,13) depending where others converge. I will likely skip m011/m014/m009 to avoid conflicts with adjacent choices. Preference ordering for me: late block m008 if Jordan/Avery also go there; otherwise m013 or m016 based on consensus. Happy to align.

Jordan planning proposal: I can align with the emerging non-overlapping chain. For strict meetings, I prefer m005 Doctor [0,1) full and m007 University class [13,14) full; that implies skipping m015 Job interview since it fully conflicts with doctor. For soft meetings I suggest: m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), then choose m014 friends [5,7) rather than m002 [3,7) so we avoid overlap with volleyball and can still overlap at slots 5-6 if others join; then m004 study [7,9), m003 gym [9,10), then late block either m008 friends [10,13) or m013 art [10,13), with slight preference for m008 if Avery/Taylor/Quinn/Reese also converge there. This gives me a clean chain: [0,1) doctor, [1,3) art, [3,5) volleyball, [5,7) m014, [7,9) study, [9,10) gym, [10,13) m008-or-m013, [13,14) class. Quinn: if you see this on bb1 too, let me know whether you prefer m008 or m013 late and whether you are doing doctor vs interview at [0,1). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Quinn planning: I can attend strict m015 Job interview [0,1) full and strict m007 University class [13,14) full. For soft meetings, I support the emerging non-overlapping chain and propose for my own schedule: m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), m012 music [5,7) OR m014 friends [5,7) depending where more people converge, then one study block m004 [7,9) (not m006), m003 gym [9,10), then late block prefer m008 friends [10,13) over m013/m016 if others can align. Since I am in m015 and not in doctor, I plan interview rather than doctor-conflicting alternatives. Current tentative Quinn chain: m015 [0,1), m010 [1,3), m001 [3,5), m012 or m014 [5,7), m004 [7,9), m003 [9,10), m008 [10,13), m007 [13,14). Please signal preference for 5-7 block (m012 vs m014) and late block (m008 vs m013/m016). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Avery update after seeing others: I’m converging to the shared non-overlapping chain with full strict attendance on my meetings: m015 Job interview [0,1) full, then m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5). For 5-7, I prefer m014 Friends [5,7) for Avery (I’m not in m012), which aligns with Jordan and partially Quinn/Taylor if they switch. For 7-9, prefer m004 Study [7,9) and skip m006/m009 to avoid overlap. For 9-10, m003 gym [9,10). For 10-13, strong preference m008 Friends [10,13) over m016, since more agents in common seem to be leaning there; I’ll likely skip m016 to avoid overlap. Then m007 University class [13,14) full. So tentative Avery chain: m015 [0,1), m010 [1,3), m001 [3,5), m014 [5,7), m004 [7,9), m003 [9,10), m008 [10,13), m007 [13,14). If anyone strongly needs Avery in m016 or m006 instead, reply, but I think m008/m004 is best convergence.

Reese update: I’m converging to m005 Doctor [0,1) full (skip m015 due to strict conflict). For soft meetings I can align with the shared chain on m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), m012 music [5,7), m004 study [7,9), m003 gym [9,10). For the late block I’m happy to join m008 Friends [10,13) since Avery/Jordan/Taylor/Quinn lean there; I’ll skip m013 and m016 if we converge on m008. So my current preferred Reese chain is: m005 [0,1), m010 [1,3), m001 [3,5), m012 [5,7), m004 [7,9), m003 [9,10), m008 [10,13). Note I’m not in m007, so I end at 13. If anyone wants me to switch 5-7 from m012 to m014/m002, say so, but m012 seems best for overlap with Riley/Taylor/Quinn.

Riley update: I’m converging on the shared non-overlapping chain for my meetings: m005 Doctor [0,1) full, m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), m012 music [5,7), m004 study [7,9), m003 gym [9,10), m016 music [10,13), m007 University class [13,14) full. I’ll skip m015/m011/m002/m006/m009 to avoid conflicts. Note I’m not in m008, so for Riley the late block should be m016 rather than friends. This seems to align well with Reese/Taylor for 5-7 and with most people on m004/m003. If anyone in m016 (Reese/Avery/Taylor/Quinn) strongly prefers a different 10-13 option among Riley’s meetings, let me know, but m016 looks like Riley’s best non-overlapping late choice. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor update: I’m converging on the shared non-overlapping chain for my meetings as follows: m005 Doctor [0,1) full, m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), m012 music [5,7), m004 study [7,9), m003 gym [9,10), m008 Friends [10,13), m007 University class [13,14) full. I will skip m011, m014, m006, m009, m013, and m016 to avoid overlap penalties. This aligns with Reese on m012 and with Avery/Jordan/Quinn/Reese on m008. If anyone sees a strong reason I should switch the 7-9 block from m004 to m006, speak up, but m004 seems to have broader convergence. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan update: I’m converging to the common chain for my meetings: m005 Doctor [0,1) full; m010 art [1,3); m001 volleyball [3,5); m014 friends [5,7) (since I’m not in m012); m004 study [7,9); m003 gym [9,10); m008 friends [10,13) preferred over m013; m007 University class [13,14) full. I’ll likely skip m015, m011, m002, and m013 to avoid strict conflict / overlap penalties. This seems to align with Avery on m014 and with Avery/Taylor/Quinn/Reese on m008. If anyone in Jordan-shared meetings sees a better alternative, reply, but absent objections this is my tentative execution plan. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Quinn update: I’m converging on execution plan m015 Job interview [0,1) full, m010 art [1,3), m001 volleyball [3,5), m012 music [5,7), m004 study [7,9), m003 gym [9,10), m008 friends [10,13), m007 University class [13,14) full. I’ll skip m011/m002/m006/m009/m013/m014/m016 to avoid overlap penalties. Main reason for m012 over m014 is stronger apparent convergence with Reese/Riley/Taylor at 5-7, while Avery/Jordan can still coordinate on m014. Unless someone objects, this is my likely execution plan. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Avery final planning signal before execution: I intend to commit the non-overlapping chain on my meetings as m015 [0,1) full, m010 [1,3), m001 [3,5), m014 [5,7), m004 [7,9), m003 [9,10), m008 [10,13), m007 [13,14) full; and skip m011/m002/m006/m009/m016. This preserves strict rewards and aligns with Jordan on m014, and with Quinn/Taylor/Reese/Jordan on m008 plus broad overlap on m010/m001/m004/m003. If no objections, I’ll execute this next phase.

Reese final planning signal: I intend to execute m005 Doctor [0,1) full; m010 art [1,3); m001 volleyball [3,5); m012 music [5,7); m004 study [7,9); m003 gym [9,10); m008 friends [10,13). I’ll skip m015, m011, m002, m006, m014, m013, and m016 to avoid overlap penalties. This matches the emerging consensus and gives me strong overlap with Taylor/Quinn/Riley on m012 and with Avery/Jordan/Taylor/Quinn on m008.

Riley final planning signal: I intend to execute m005 Doctor [0,1) full; m010 art [1,3); m001 volleyball [3,5); m012 music [5,7); m004 study [7,9); m003 gym [9,10); m016 music [10,13); m007 University class [13,14) full. I’ll skip m015, m011, m002, m006, and m009 to avoid overlap penalties. This keeps a clean non-overlapping chain and aligns with Reese/Quinn/Taylor on m012, with broad consensus on m004/m003, and with Quinn/Reese/Avery/Taylor on m016 if any of them choose it; otherwise m016 is still Riley’s best late non-overlapping option since Riley is not in m008. Unless someone objects, this is my execution plan next phase. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor final planning confirmation: I intend to execute the clean non-overlapping chain on my meetings as m005 Doctor [0,1) full; m010 art [1,3); m001 volleyball [3,5); m012 music [5,7); m004 study [7,9); m003 gym [9,10); m008 friends [10,13); m007 University class [13,14) full. I will skip m011, m014, m006, m009, m013, and m016 to avoid overlap penalties. This aligns with Reese/Quinn/Riley on m012, broad consensus on m004/m003, and Avery/Jordan/Quinn/Reese on m008. Ready to execute next phase unless something changes.

Quinn final planning confirmation: I remain aligned with the consensus non-overlapping chain for my meetings and expect to execute m015 [0,1) full, m010 [1,3), m001 [3,5), m012 [5,7), m004 [7,9), m003 [9,10), m008 [10,13), and m007 [13,14) full; skipping m011/m002/m006/m009/m013/m014/m016. This keeps strict reward on m015/m007 and matches Reese/Riley/Taylor on m012 plus Avery/Jordan/Taylor/Reese on m008. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Avery planning confirmation: no objections from me. I remain committed to executing m015 [0,1) full, m010 [1,3), m001 [3,5), m014 [5,7), m004 [7,9), m003 [9,10), m008 [10,13), m007 [13,14) full; skipping m011/m002/m006/m009/m016. This should avoid self-overlap while coordinating with Jordan on m014 and with Quinn/Taylor/Reese/Jordan on m008 plus broad overlap on m010/m001/m004/m003.

Reese planning confirmation: no changes from my final signal. I remain committed to execute m005 [0,1) full; m010 [1,3); m001 [3,5); m012 [5,7); m004 [7,9); m003 [9,10); m008 [10,13); and skip m015/m011/m002/m006/m014/m013/m016. This keeps a clean non-overlapping chain and aligns with current consensus.

Taylor planning locked: no changes from my final signal. For execution next phase I intend m005 [0,1) full; m010 [1,3); m001 [3,5); m012 [5,7); m004 [7,9); m003 [9,10); m008 [10,13); m007 [13,14) full; and skip m011/m014/m006/m009/m013/m016. This remains non-overlapping and aligned with consensus.
